At first, Grace found it difficult to keep the habit. The tea house looked quieter than usual that evening. Amy and Grace are preparing a report about the tea house. The pizza has extra cheese on top.
On Wednesday evenings, Grace reviews the notes from class. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Little by little, things began to change. Also, the feta is salty and pleasingly crumbly.
Grace's dream job is to be a doctor. Amy always says that small steps matter more than big plans. Grace wrote down every idea in a small notebook. She is interested in ancient history.

There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Grace has practiced badminton for three years and won a prize last term. The night snack bar has become an important part of daily life. What's more, season the eggs with salt and pepper.
They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem.
